Haris Family Dentistry & Cosmetic Center

A reason to smile again.

Dental and aesthetic care with Dr. Haris Muhammad Wali-ur-Rahman and Dr. Sufia Rahaman Brishty in Dhanmondi, Dhaka.

Care, explained clearly.

Our clinic brings together family dentistry, restorative and cosmetic dental care, facial aesthetics and permanent makeup. A consultation gives you the opportunity to discuss your concerns, understand your options and agree on the next steps with your doctor.

Dr. Haris’s work includes smile design, aesthetic restorations and dental mentoring. Dr. Sufia combines dentistry with facial aesthetics, micropigmentation and permanent makeup. Both doctors also share their experience through professional training.
